source_title: India Saurav Das's Citizenship Under Scanner? Madras HC Seeks Response From Centre
source_excerpt:
The Madras High Court has issued notices to Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) leader Saurav Das and the Central Government on a petition seeking an investigation into his citizenship and a block on his social media accounts.
The petition was filed by Ganesh Kumar, a businessman from Kancheepuram district. A Division Bench comprising Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan heard the matter.
The petitioner has sought a detailed investigation into Saurav Das's citizenship, identity and background.
ALSO READ: Uttarakhand Helicopter Loses Contact Over Joshimath Valley, Tracking Signal Disappears Moments Before Crash
He has also requested that Das's passport and Aadhaar card be cancelled if he is found not to be an Indian citizen.
The petitioner has further sought the blocking of Saurav Das's X (formerly Twitter) and Instagram accounts, alleging that they were being used to circulate derogatory remarks about Supreme Court judges and the judiciary.
The court has issued notices to the Union Ministry of Home Affairs, Saurav Das and other respondents, asking them to file their replies.
